research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Starling Medical is researching bodily fluid management systems titled Bodily fluid management system. The abstracts describe systems, devices and methods for monitoring bodily fluid, periodically collecting samples to establish a baseline composition and detect changes over time. One external bladder management system resides in a urine collection receptacle with a fluid testing chamber, enabling ongoing bodily fluid analysis and external bladder monitoring as key areas of research and development.
